separation_from_prior_target.reason: Discovery candidates must not recycle the already-inspected frozen target neighborhood.

look_elsewhere.extreme_definition: value is at or beyond the empirical 0.5th or 99.5th percentile among all eligible candidate centers at the same radius
look_elsewhere.family_vote_rule: At most one vote per metric family even if several correlated metrics in the family are extreme.
look_elsewhere.followup_flag_rule: At least two distinct metric-family votes at the same radius, and at least one vote must come from CURVATURE_FAMILY, RADIAL_FAMILY, or ANGULAR_FAMILY.

spatial_deduplication.ordering: descending family_vote_count, then descending maximum empirical tail extremeness; ties lexicographic source_file then record_index

independent_confirmation_routes: raw XSE reprocessing with frozen processing parameters
independent CD169 2005 bathymetry/TOBI where spatially overlapping
another independently acquired multibeam survey where available
